options.name: --adrs
options.description: Directory of hand-authored architecture decision records.  Default: <repo root>/docs/adrs.

options.name: --as-of
options.description: Pin the date-page "today" cutoff to a fixed  calendar date (e.g. 2026-07-27), so a regenerated portal reproduces the same  date-page set regardless of when or where it runs. Implies the fixed-date policy — do not also pass --today-policy. A date before the first commit is  accepted and simply yields no commit date pages. Default: unset (the cutoff  follows --today-policy).

options.name: --code-url
options.description: Base URL for source-file links (e.g.  https://github.com/owner/repo/blob/main). Adds a 'view source online'  link to each in-portal code page (the pages are always generated). Default:  unset, and auto-detected from the git remote or GitHub Pages context when  available.

options.name: --deep-git
options.description: Enable deeper git analytics (change coupling and hotspots) as an opt-in dashboard panel. Default: off, so baseline generation performance  is unaffected.

options.name: --no-readme
options.description: Exclude the repository README.md from the generated site.  Default: the README is included.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory the HTML site is written to. Default: <repo root>/SpecScribeOutput.

options.name: --project-name
options.description: Name the site is branded with. Default: project_name from  _bmad/config.toml.

options.name: --serve
options.description: `webview` only: stay resident and stream one  JSON payload per line (NDJSON) on stdout after every incremental regen, instead  of rendering once and exiting. Reuses the same debounced  file-watch/incremental-regen path as `specscribe watch`, so a  live-push no longer reruns a full generation from scratch. Default: off (render  once and exit).

options.name: --serve-delta
options.description: `webview --serve` only: after the first (full)  payload, stream DELTA frames carrying only the surfaces that changed, instead of re-shipping the whole site on every save. Opt-in so an older extension against a newer core is unaffected. Default: off (every push is a full payload).

options.name: --show-config
options.description: Print the effective configuration and where each value  came from (command line, .specscribe, or auto-discovery), then exit without  generating. Default: off.

options.name: --source
options.description: Directory of spec artifacts to render. Default: walks up  from the current directory to find _bmad-output.

options.name: --spa
options.description: DEPRECATED, no-op. The JSON intermediate representation  under spa/ is now emitted on every run — it is the canonical output, and  the static pages are rendered from it. Accepted and ignored so existing scripts  keep working; it will be removed in a future release.

options.name: --today-policy
options.description: How to decide which calendar day is "today" when generating date pages and date links: machine-local (the generating  machine's day), utc (the UTC calendar day), or last-commit (the latest  authored commit day). Default: machine-local. Governs only the day cutoff — commit times always render in their own authored offset.
